note: BLM campground on the rim of Muddy Mountain south of Casper, overlooking the valley, reached the same way as Lodgepole: WY-251 over Casper Mountain, County Road 505, then 4.5 miles of BLM gravel road. Water is available at Lodgepole; a 2-mile accessible interpretive trail links the two campgrounds. Spotty cell reception. --Claude
summary: BLM page read: 8 sites incl. a few pull-throughs, double vault toilet, no water (Lodgepole has it), $7 + $3 second vehicle, half off for Access/Senior pass, cash/check, 14-day limit. rec.gov is a POI only -> reservable false / fcfs always. Season unstated. Pin on the entrance spur, fine. Phone 307-261-7600 confirmed.
flags: WEBSITE: the first website line, https://www.recreation.gov/camping/poi/274354, is a non-bookable information page; suggest putting https://www.blm.gov/visit/rim-campground first (or dropping the POI line). Phone 307-261-7600 (BLM Casper Field Office) confirmed.

PIN: stored 42.680857,-106.25858 (= the BLM point) is on the entrance spur; the lot is ~70 m north and the site spurs run east under pines - within ~150 m, no move. Not waterfront holds (mountain rim, no water).
